# Central City Community Health Center, Inc.

> > Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) providing comprehensive healthcare services across Los Angeles, Orange, and Riverside counties with sliding fee scales and Medi-Cal enrollment assistance.

Central City Community Health Center operates multiple community clinics in Southern California, offering family practice, women's health, OB/GYN, psychiatry, and pharmacy services. The organization serves underserved populations through the 340B Drug Pricing Program and community outreach initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC)
- Medi-Cal enrollment and services
- 340B Drug Pricing Program
- Women's health and prenatal care
- CPSP (Comprehensive Perinatal Services Program)
- Sliding fee scale
- Community health outreach
- E-prescription services
- Family practice
- OB/GYN services
- Covered California
- Pharmacy partner network
- Los Angeles County
- Orange County
- Riverside County

## Healthcare Services

- [Women's Health](https://centralcityhealth.org/services/womens-health): Women's health services including prenatal care and CPSP program
- [Community Health Programs](https://centralcityhealth.org/community-health): Community outreach programs for underserved populations across 3 counties

## Clinic Locations

- [Indio Community Clinic](https://centralcityhealth.org/locations/indio-clinic): Indio clinic location offering family practice, psychiatry & Medi-Cal
- [Stanton Community Health Clinic](https://centralcityhealth.org/locations/stanton-2): Stanton clinic on Beach Blvd with family practice, OB/GYN & social work

## Pharmacy Services

- [Preferred Partner Pharmacy Network](https://centralcityhealth.org/preferred-partner-pharmacy-1): 340B Drug Pricing Program pharmacy partners including Walgreens & Walmart

## Patient Resources

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://centralcityhealth.org/faq): FAQ covering customer service, returns, shipping & general inquiries
- [Heart Attack Awareness](https://centralcityhealth.org/health-check): Educational article on heart attack symptoms and gender differences

## Optional

- [Notice of Non-Discrimination](https://centralcityhealth.org/notice-nondiscrimination): Civil rights and non-discrimination policy statement
- [Sponsorship Opportunities](https://centralcityhealth.org/sponsorship): Sponsorship opportunities for San Gabriel Valley Sports Recognition event
- [Community Events Archive 2017-18](https://centralcityhealth.org/community-health/community-events-2017-18): Archive of 2017-18 health fairs and community outreach events
